pages.text: Everything the printer makes is paid for in $(l)Filament Units (FU)$(). Feed materials into a $(item)Filament Winder$() to wind FU onto a $(item)Filament Spool$(), then Shift+Right Click the spool onto a printer's side.$(br2)Conversion is symmetric: a diamond yields exactly what printing a diamond costs.

pages.title: Tier Gating
pages.text: A winder can only process materials of its tier or below — a Tier 1 winder refuses diamonds. Printers enforce the same rule when printing, so progression can't be bypassed.$(br2)Lower-tier machines are also less efficient: a T1 printer pays double the base FU cost.
